properties.Text: Specters are strongly bound to their favorite room. When in the same room as one, many say they feel an ominous sense of unease. Specters are known for their profound control over their environment.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Spirits are a manifestation of the souls of the deceased. They are able to project into the physical world and have been observed to manipulate electronic frequencies. They are often eager to communicate with the living and are generally considered harmless.

properties.Text: Spirits have no documented strengths. They can alter the flame color of candles.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: The namesake of the Umbra Board, Umbras are elusive, shadowy apparitions born from fear. As they weigh as much as a shadow, they make no sound when walking. Their presence is often said to be deeply unsettling.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Umbras do not make footstep sounds. They move slower in lit rooms.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vespers rely solely on sound to hunt. They can track through walls.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vespers are the malignant lingering souls of creatures living in complete darkness. They've evolved to rely solely on their auditory senses, a sort of echolocation, making them adept hunters despite lacking ocular vision of any kind.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vex's are invisible on LIDAR Scans. They can walk through walls.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vexes, while not a ghost in the traditional sense, are presences that acts as the physical embodiment of anger and displeasure. They do not occupy the physical space in the same way we'd expect from other ghosts.

properties.Text: Wisps can walk through fire. They can only start a hunt in their favorite room.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Wraiths quickly deplete energy from hunters. They refuse to disturb lines of salt.

properties.Text: Wraiths are malevolent, shadowy apparitions, noted for their profound aggression. They are known to inflict an impending sense of doom on people around them. Be wary when interacting with a Wraith in any capacity.

properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Written here is a brief description for Demonology Solutions, LLC issued equipment items and how to utilize them.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a ghost steps through a salt pile, if it has Prints evidence, it is guaranteed to leave a footprint behind. This is a great way to prove or disprove Prints evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Shine the blacklight on surfaces - especially doors - to check for handprints, fingerprints, or footprints. These are considered "Prints" evidence
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Blacklights emit ultraviolet radiation that enables us to see things that are otherwise imperceptible to the naked eye.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A common misconception is that a cross can stop a hunt while it is happening, but in reality, a cross can only prevent a hunt before it occurs. Crosses have a larger effective range against Demons.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a cross is in-range of a ghost that tries to hunt, the cross will burn up and prevent the hunt. A burned cross can not be used again.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Crosses are powerful talismans that, when near a ghost, have the ability to prevent them from hunting.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text:
EMF sources have a "Max Strength" reading, but are primarily based on your proximity to the source.

All ghosts will cause the EMF Reader to malfunction during a hunt, giving inaccurate and wildly random readings.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: The EMF Reader is a tool used to track ghost activity. Anytime a ghost performs an action, it gives off an electromagnetic frequency.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If all 5 indicator lights turn on, this can be logged as a piece of evidence - "EMF Level 5". If less than 5 turn on, this represents a specific type of activity.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If a ghost interacts with a flower pot and the flowers will wilt and die, this means the ghost has "Wither" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Outside of Flowers, a way to find Wither evidence is by noticing metal rusting, or paintings being distorted on the walls - but make sure you observe the change.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Flowers are our tool for procuring Wither evidence, by observing wilting or dead flowers.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Holy Oil does not ignite if it is placed while a hunt is ongoing, and can only burn once. Once it has burned, it can not be ignited again.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Holy Oil is our primary method of defending ourselves from ghosts during a hunt.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: You can pour out a line of Holy Oil, which will ignite whenever the ghost begins a hunt. Ghosts are unable to cross through the fire caused by Holy Oil.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: H O L Y  O I L
properties.Name: Title

properties.Text: When you scan a room, dots will map out every object in your view. If the color of the dots are red, this indicates the presence of a ghost.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: LIDAR Scanners are mapping tools that can be particularly useful for finding the ghost's current location.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: LIDAR Scanners do not themselves yield evidence, however knowing the ghost's location can be useful for gathering other types of evidence. Green dots correspond to equipment, red dots correspond to the ghost.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts with Laser Projector evidence occasionally enter into a form that makes them visible to Laser Projectors. Be careful not to confuse ghost events with Laser Projector evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Laser Projectors contain a bright light emitting diode that is passed through a cover to project a number of dots on the surrounding area.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If a ghost becomes slightly opaque when passing through the light of a laser projector, you can mark this as "Laser Projector" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Photos that yield monetary rewards are rated on a scale of 1-3 stars, based on the quality of the photo. The bigger the object in the picture, the higher the rating.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Photo Cameras are our primary way of keeping a record of evidence - certain photos can earn you monetary rewards.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Point your camera at an object and take a photo - if you capture an artifact or ghost activity, the company may pay you for it!
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a plushie is "possessed", it will float in the air. While in this state, ghosts with Spirit Box evidence are guaranteed to give a Spirit Box reply.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If you are too far away from the Plushie when asking the Spirit Box a question, the ghost will not be able to give a guaranteed reply. Make sure you are mindful of your positioning when trying to interact with a Plushie being used as a vessel.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts have a particular affinity to plushies, and will regularly use them as vessels to communicate with ghost hunters.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If the ghost chooses to write in the book, it will pick up the pencil and scribble a message on the pages. You can mark this as "Inscription" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts don't always write in the Spirit Book instantly - make sure you place the book near the ghost and be patient. If a ghost throws a book outside of a hunt, this disproves Inscription evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Spirit Books are special journals that the ghost is able to interact with, writing various messages to communicate.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: In order to receive a response from the Spirit Box, the ghost must have Spirit Box evidence and you must be near them when asking a question. The ghost will not reply if the lights are turned on in your current room or if you are too far away.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A Spirit Box is a device that allows ghosts to combine different radio frequencies to produce a vocal response to a question.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When the red light turns on, the spirit box has heard your question. When the ghost responds, you will hear a voice and the blue light will turn on. This is "Spirit Box" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Our Thermometers are no different than your run-of-the-mill outdoor thermometers - they track the temperature of any given room.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If you see any temperature below freezing - 0.00C or 32.00F - or you see your own breath, this is "Freezing Temperatures" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When the ghost is in a room, it's temperature will gradually drop - if the ghost has Freezing Temperatures evidence, the room will eventually reach a temperature at or below freezing.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Video Cameras are a mutlifaceted tool, particularly useful for identifying Ghost Orbs, but also provide night vision for visibility.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Be careful when identifying a ghost orb, as the Doppelganger is able to fake ghost orb evidence. Some job sites have floating dust, which should not be confused with a ghost orb.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Using the video camera, you may see a small white orb floating around the screen, this can be marked as "Ghost Orb" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: EMF Level 5 evidence can only be proven if all 5 lights on your EMF Reader turn on.

properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If you are too far away from the Plushie when asking the Spirit Box a question, the ghost will not be able to give a guaranteed reply. Make sure you are mindful of your positioning when trying to interact with a Plushie being used as a vessel.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts have a particular affinity to plushies, and will regularly use them as vessels to communicate with ghost hunters.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts don't always write in the Spirit Book instantly - make sure you place the book near the ghost and be patient. If a ghost throws a book outside of a hunt, this disproves Inscription evidence.

properties.Text: Spirit Books are special journals that the ghost is able to interact with, writing various messages to communicate.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If the ghost chooses to write in the book, it will pick up the pencil and scribble a message on the pages. You can mark this as "Inscription" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A Spirit Box is a device that allows ghosts to combine different radio frequencies to produce a vocal response to a question.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When the red light turns on, the spirit box has heard your question. When the ghost responds, you will hear a voice and the blue light will turn on. This is "Spirit Box" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: In order to receive a response from the Spirit Box, the ghost must have Spirit Box evidence and you must be near them when asking a question. The ghost will not reply if the lights are turned on in your current room or if you are too far away.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When the ghost is in a room, it's temperature will gradually drop - if the ghost has Freezing Temperatures evidence, the room will eventually reach a temperature at or below freezing.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If you see any temperature below freezing - 0.00C or 32.00F - or you see your own breath, this is "Freezing Temperatures" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Our Thermometers are no different than your run-of-the-mill outdoor thermometers - they track the temperature of any given room.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Be careful when identifying a ghost orb, as the Doppelganger is able to fake ghost orb evidence. Some job sites have floating dust, which should not be confused with a ghost orb.

properties.Text: Wraiths are malevolent, shadowy apparitions, noted for their profound aggression. They are known to inflict an impending sense of doom on people around them. Be wary when interacting with a Wraith in any capacity.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Wraiths quickly deplete energy from hunters. They refuse to disturb lines of salt.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Spirits are a manifestation of the souls of the deceased. They are able to project into the physical world and have been observed to manipulate electronic frequencies. They are often eager to communicate with the living and are generally considered harmless.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Spirits have no documented strengths. They can alter the flame color of candles.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghouls are regarded as troublemaking ghosts, more focused on "playing" than harming. They often engage in behavior to frighten people in their vicinity, but are quick to anger. Exercise caution when in the presence of a Ghoul.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghouls may become enraged if they hear talking. They can't disable electronics.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Phantoms blink slower during hunts, and move faster while invisible.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Phantoms are ethereal apparitions that manifest less frequently than similar ghosts. They are misattributed as "shy," and "timid," but can certainly be aggressive. They are commonly associated with and can be aggravated by intense emotions.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Shadows are barely perceptible apparitions that rarely interact with their environment, preferring to reside calmly in the dark. They are shy, and tend to avoid people, though are known to be defensive of their favorite room.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Shadows do not alter the temperature much. They are less active in well-lit rooms.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: USE EXTREME CAUTION WHEN INTERACTING WITH A DEMON! THEY ARE EXTREMELY HOSTILE AND DANGEROUS!
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: DEMONS HUNT FREQUENTLY. CROSSES ARE MORE EFFECTIVE ON THEM.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Specters are strongly bound to their favorite room. When in the same room as one, many say they feel an ominous sense of unease. Specters are known for their profound control over their environment.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Specters are more likely to throw items. They do not roam except while hunting.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: The Entity is a powerful force that transcends typical hauntings. While it's control over the environment is limited, it has been observed to teleport, granting it heavy influence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: The Entity can teleport, and can also teleport items before throwing them.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Doppelgangers are elusive ghosts with the unique ability to mimic the abilities of other ghost types. They are frequent roamers, spending more time outside of their favorite room. Identifying Doppelgangers requires extreme precision.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Doppelgangers can fake Ghost Orb evidence. They can mimic other ghosts' abilities.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text:
Banshees are characterized as harbingers of death and demise. They most commonly manifest as wailing and mournful spirits, occupying spaces where misfortune is bound to occur. Be less cautious of them, and more of what they may be warning
you of.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Banshees are more likely to break glass. They might use a distinct wail when hunting.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Wretches are horribly malformed creatures, less ghost than monstrous caricature. Wretches are incredibly afraid of fire, making candles and lanterns good tools for fending them off - still, it is best to be cautious.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Wretches won't start a hunt near a lit flame. They move faster as average energy lowers.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Nightmares, as the name suggests, commonly manifest themselves as bad dreams and are usually harmless, however particularly powerful nightmares can instead take form in the physical world, exhibiting much of the same behavior expected from an average ghost.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Nightmares can cause hallucinations. They hunt more often in the dark.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Leviathans are ancient monsters from the deepest parts of the sea where no light reaches. Their presence drowns nearby electricity, causing lights and equipment to fail.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Leviathans can flicker equipment and disable lights outside of hunts.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Onis are a class of ghost believed to originate in Japan, but sightings have been reported all across the globe. They are known for manifesting often and having a terrifying physical appearance.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Onis sprint during hunts. They manifest more commonly than other ghosts.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: The namesake of the Umbra Board, Umbras are elusive, shadowy apparitions born from fear. As they weigh as much as a shadow, they make no sound when walking. Their presence is often said to be deeply unsettling.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Umbras do not make footstep sounds. They move slower in lit rooms.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Will-o-the-Wisp, commonly known as The Wisp or just "Wisp," is a spirit that typically haunts swamps, but has recently been observed invading homes and other buildings. They have a particular affinity for fire.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Wisps can walk through fire. They can only start a hunt in their favorite room.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Revenants are highly vengeful, often drawing their strength not from fear, but from anger. They are relentless, hunting anyone they have the opportunity to hunt. They are unstoppable when enraged.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Revenants have a low hunt cooldown. They will rest if they've killed someone.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Sirens are most known for their distinct singing voice which they commonly use to lure sailors to their demise, though they have also been seen roaming far away from the ocean.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Sirens slow people they see while hunting. They always respond in a female voice.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Keep an ear out for their unique humming sound that you can hear through the spirit box.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Dybbuks are malicious ghosts that have a strong association with possession and pursue a specific goal or ideal before parting from the mortal plane. They have the unique ability to interact with corpses.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Dybbuks can throw corpses. They are stunned when a Music Box is first played.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Dullahans appear headless in photos. They move faster the longer they see their target.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Dullahans, more commonly known as Headless Horsemen, are legendary characters of folklore, often traveling long distances on their horses, they can be very dangerous when they decide to stick around.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vespers rely solely on sound to hunt. They can track through walls.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vespers are the malignant lingering souls of creatures living in complete darkness. They've evolved to rely solely on their auditory senses, a sort of echolocation, making them adept hunters despite lacking ocular vision of any kind.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Keres' speed decreases with each kill. They target hunters with the lowest energy.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Keres are best described as angels of death. They wander aiming to feed on the souls of the deceased. They prey on the weakest
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: targets that they are able to sense. It is best to remain mindful of your energy levels and keep them high when dealing with a Keres to avoid being targeted.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vex's are invisible on LIDAR Scans. They can walk through walls.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vexes, while not a ghost in the traditional sense, are presences that acts as the physical embodiment of anger and displeasure. They do not occupy the physical space in the same way we'd expect from other ghosts.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A Ravager is a violent manifestation that uses the environment as a weapon. Ravagers announce themselves through destruction. Overturned furniture, thrown objects, and sudden bursts of chaotic movement.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ravagers can throw multiple objects at once. All abilites leave EMF Level 5.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Aswang's speed increases every time they kill. Walking through salt slows them.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Aswangs have historically only been reported in the Philippines and surrounding areas
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: but have recently been increasingly common on a global scale. They are vampiric creatures empowered by death with seemingly no desire outside of attacking people.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: The EMF Reader is a tool used to track ghost activity. Anytime a ghost performs an action, it gives off an electromagnetic frequency.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If all 5 indicator lights turn on, this can be logged as a piece of evidence - "EMF Level 5". If less than 5 turn on, this represents a specific type of activity.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text:
EMF sources have a "Max Strength" reading, but are primarily based on your proximity to the source.

All ghosts will cause the EMF Reader to malfunction during a hunt, giving inaccurate and wildly random readings.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Blacklights emit ultraviolet radiation that enables us to see things that are otherwise imperceptible to the naked eye.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Shine the blacklight on surfaces - especially doors - to check for handprints, fingerprints, or footprints. These are considered "Prints" evidence
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a ghost steps through a salt pile, if it has Prints evidence, it is guaranteed to leave a footprint behind. This is a great way to prove or disprove Prints evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Our Thermometers are no different than your run-of-the-mill outdoor thermometers - they track the temperature of any given room.

properties.Text: Laser Projectors contain a bright light emitting diode that is passed through a cover to project a number of dots on the surrounding area.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If a ghost becomes slightly opaque when passing through the light of a laser projector, you can mark this as "Laser Projector" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts with Laser Projector evidence occasionally enter into a form that makes them visible to Laser Projectors. Be careful not to confuse ghost events with Laser Projector evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Crosses are powerful talismans that, when near a ghost, have the ability to prevent them from hunting.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a cross is in-range of a ghost that tries to hunt, the cross will burn up and prevent the hunt. A burned cross can not be used again.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A common misconception is that a cross can stop a hunt while it is happening, but in reality, a cross can only prevent a hunt before it occurs. Crosses have a larger effective range against Demons.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Photo Cameras are our primary way of keeping a record of evidence - certain photos can earn you monetary rewards.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Point your camera at an object and take a photo - if you capture an artifact or ghost activity, the company may pay you for it!
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Photos that yield monetary rewards are rated on a scale of 1-3 stars, based on the quality of the photo. The bigger the object in the picture, the higher the rating.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Holy Oil is our primary method of defending ourselves from ghosts during a hunt.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: H O L Y  O I L
properties.Name: Title

properties.Text: You can pour out a line of Holy Oil, which will ignite whenever the ghost begins a hunt. Ghosts are unable to cross through the fire caused by Holy Oil.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Holy Oil does not ignite if it is placed while a hunt is ongoing, and can only burn once. Once it has burned, it can not be ignited again.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: LIDAR Scanners are mapping tools that can be particularly useful for finding the ghost's current location.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When you scan a room, dots will map out every object in your view. If the color of the dots are red, this indicates the presence of a ghost.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: LIDAR Scanners do not themselves yield evidence, however knowing the ghost's location can be useful for gathering other types of evidence. Green dots correspond to equipment, red dots correspond to the ghost.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Flowers are our tool for procuring Wither evidence, by observing wilting or dead flowers.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If a ghost interacts with a flower pot and the flowers will wilt and die, this means the ghost has "Wither" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Outside of Flowers, a way to find Wither evidence is by noticing metal rusting, or paintings being distorted on the walls - but make sure you observe the change.

properties.Text: Vespers rely solely on sound to hunt. They can track through walls.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vespers are the malignant lingering souls of creatures living in complete darkness. They've evolved to rely solely on their auditory senses, a sort of echolocation, making them adept hunters despite lacking ocular vision of any kind.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Keres' speed decreases with each kill. They target hunters with the lowest energy.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Keres are best described as angels of death. They wander aiming to feed on the souls of the deceased. They prey on the weakest
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: targets that they are able to sense. It is best to remain mindful of your energy levels and keep them high when dealing with a Keres to avoid being targeted.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vex's are invisible on LIDAR Scans. They can walk through walls.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Vexes, while not a ghost in the traditional sense, are presences that acts as the physical embodiment of anger and displeasure. They do not occupy the physical space in the same way we'd expect from other ghosts.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A Ravager is a violent manifestation that uses the environment as a weapon. Ravagers announce themselves through destruction. Overturned furniture, thrown objects, and sudden bursts of chaotic movement.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ravagers can throw multiple objects at once. All abilites leave EMF Level 5.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Aswang's speed increases every time they kill. Walking through salt slows them.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Aswangs have historically only been reported in the Philippines and surrounding areas
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: but have recently been increasingly common on a global scale. They are vampiric creatures empowered by death with seemingly no desire outside of attacking people.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Written here is a brief description for Demonology Solutions, LLC issued equipment items and how to utilize them.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: The EMF Reader is a tool used to track ghost activity. Anytime a ghost performs an action, it gives off an electromagnetic frequency.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If all 5 indicator lights turn on, this can be logged as a piece of evidence - "EMF Level 5". If less than 5 turn on, this represents a specific type of activity.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text:
EMF sources have a "Max Strength" reading, but are primarily based on your proximity to the source.

All ghosts will cause the EMF Reader to malfunction during a hunt, giving inaccurate and wildly random readings.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A Spirit Box is a device that allows ghosts to combine different radio frequencies to produce a vocal response to a question.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When the red light turns on, the spirit box has heard your question. When the ghost responds, you will hear a voice and the blue light will turn on. This is "Spirit Box" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: In order to receive a response from the Spirit Box, the ghost must have Spirit Box evidence and you must be near them when asking a question. The ghost will not reply if the lights are turned on in your current room or if you are too far away.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Spirit Books are special journals that the ghost is able to interact with, writing various messages to communicate.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If the ghost chooses to write in the book, it will pick up the pencil and scribble a message on the pages. You can mark this as "Inscription" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts don't always write in the Spirit Book instantly - make sure you place the book near the ghost and be patient. If a ghost throws a book outside of a hunt, this disproves Inscription evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Video Cameras are a mutlifaceted tool, particularly useful for identifying Ghost Orbs, but also provide night vision for visibility.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Using the video camera, you may see a small white orb floating around the screen, this can be marked as "Ghost Orb" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Be careful when identifying a ghost orb, as the Doppelganger is able to fake ghost orb evidence. Some job sites have floating dust, which should not be confused with a ghost orb.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Blacklights emit ultraviolet radiation that enables us to see things that are otherwise imperceptible to the naked eye.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Shine the blacklight on surfaces - especially doors - to check for handprints, fingerprints, or footprints. These are considered "Prints" evidence
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a ghost steps through a salt pile, if it has Prints evidence, it is guaranteed to leave a footprint behind. This is a great way to prove or disprove Prints evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Our Thermometers are no different than your run-of-the-mill outdoor thermometers - they track the temperature of any given room.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If you see any temperature below freezing - 0.00C or 32.00F - or you see your own breath, this is "Freezing Temperatures" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When the ghost is in a room, it's temperature will gradually drop - if the ghost has Freezing Temperatures evidence, the room will eventually reach a temperature at or below freezing.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Laser Projectors contain a bright light emitting diode that is passed through a cover to project a number of dots on the surrounding area.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If a ghost becomes slightly opaque when passing through the light of a laser projector, you can mark this as "Laser Projector" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts with Laser Projector evidence occasionally enter into a form that makes them visible to Laser Projectors. Be careful not to confuse ghost events with Laser Projector evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Crosses are powerful talismans that, when near a ghost, have the ability to prevent them from hunting.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a cross is in-range of a ghost that tries to hunt, the cross will burn up and prevent the hunt. A burned cross can not be used again.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: A common misconception is that a cross can stop a hunt while it is happening, but in reality, a cross can only prevent a hunt before it occurs. Crosses have a larger effective range against Demons.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Photo Cameras are our primary way of keeping a record of evidence - certain photos can earn you monetary rewards.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Point your camera at an object and take a photo - if you capture an artifact or ghost activity, the company may pay you for it!
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Photos that yield monetary rewards are rated on a scale of 1-3 stars, based on the quality of the photo. The bigger the object in the picture, the higher the rating.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Holy Oil is our primary method of defending ourselves from ghosts during a hunt.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: H O L Y  O I L
properties.Name: Title

properties.Text: You can pour out a line of Holy Oil, which will ignite whenever the ghost begins a hunt. Ghosts are unable to cross through the fire caused by Holy Oil.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Holy Oil does not ignite if it is placed while a hunt is ongoing, and can only burn once. Once it has burned, it can not be ignited again.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: LIDAR Scanners are mapping tools that can be particularly useful for finding the ghost's current location.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When you scan a room, dots will map out every object in your view. If the color of the dots are red, this indicates the presence of a ghost.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: LIDAR Scanners do not themselves yield evidence, however knowing the ghost's location can be useful for gathering other types of evidence. Green dots correspond to equipment, red dots correspond to the ghost.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Flowers are our tool for procuring Wither evidence, by observing wilting or dead flowers.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If a ghost interacts with a flower pot and the flowers will wilt and die, this means the ghost has "Wither" evidence.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Outside of Flowers, a way to find Wither evidence is by noticing metal rusting, or paintings being distorted on the walls - but make sure you observe the change.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: Ghosts have a particular affinity to plushies, and will regularly use them as vessels to communicate with ghost hunters.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: When a plushie is "possessed", it will float in the air. While in this state, ghosts with Spirit Box evidence are guaranteed to give a Spirit Box reply.
properties.Name: Subtext

properties.Text: If you are too far away from the Plushie when asking the Spirit Box a question, the ghost will not be able to give a guaranteed reply. Make sure you are mindful of your positioning when trying to interact with a Plushie being used as a vessel.
properties.Name: Subtext
